summary: MGI Joyce|Dickson is a Griffith (Canberra) ACT accounting and advisory firm and MGI network member. Matthew Bramhall has been a Partner since March 2021 and lists Outsourced Financial Controller among his specialties. The firm sells external CFO services including monthly management reports and was recruiting a Senior Financial Controller and Business Services seniors in May 2026. Two emails already sent (16 and 23 Nov 2026); follow-ups take new angles.

claims.text: Matthew Bramhall is listed on LinkedIn as a current Partner at MGI Joyce|Dickson, in the role since March 2021.

claims.text: In May 2026 the firm advertised a Senior Financial Controller (Hybrid - Client & Internal) role alongside an Office Manager.
In May 2026 the firm said it was continuing to grow and recruiting a Senior Accountant and a Senior Advisor / Manager for Business Services.
claims.quote: we are continuing to grow across the firm and are excited to advertise two additional opportunities within our Business Services Team.

claims.text: The firm's external CFO service includes preparation of monthly management reports.
The external CFO offer is positioned as specialist CFO support on demand for businesses that do not need a full-time CFO.
claims.quote: a lot of businesses don’t require a full-time CFO, which is why they offer a cost effective option of accessing specialist CFO support on demand

claims.text: The firm can supply accountants, bookkeepers or CFOs to clients depending on their needs.
claims.quote: Whether you need the assistance of an accountant, bookkeeper or CFO, we can ensure you have access to the resources you need when you need them.

claims.text: The firm's careers page cites access to a national and global network through MGI Australasia.
claims.quote: Access to a national and global network through MGI Australasia.

hooks.text: May 2026 Senior Financial Controller (client and internal) hire plus Matthew's own Outsourced FC specialty: the controller function is being scaled and close work sits under it.
External CFO service includes monthly management reports, which depend on reconciled books every month.
Matthew lists cash flow management and business process improvement as his focus.

risks.text: Two emails already sent to Matthew with no reply logged; a third angle is the last in the sequence. The firm is tax and SMSF heavy, with external CFO as one line of service.
Part of the MGI network, so tooling decisions may involve network standards.

gaps: No personal posts, podcasts or articles by Matthew found beyond his firm bio and a 2022 award finalist listing.
No evidence of the firm's practice software stack (Xero, MYOB, Dext etc.).
No Facebook or Instagram activity found.
A 2021 news article put the firm at 50 staff against 39 in the account record; not cited.
